artifact_observations.reasoning: The lower-left section of the armor appears slightly distorted or 'melted' into the background/mannequin stand, lacking the rigid definition seen in the rest of the plate.

The lacing/straps on the right side appear physically implausible; they seem to float or merge with the metal rather than threading through distinct eyelets, suggesting a generation error in complex mechanical details.

selected_experts.reason: To verify the specific type of armor and distinguish it from generic vests or other torso coverings.
To check for edge bleeding between the metal armor and the black mannequin/background, especially around the suspicious left side panel.
To assess the overall coherence of the metallic reflections and identify any subtle rendering artifacts in the ornamental details.

focus_areas: Boundary sharpness between armor and mannequin
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the side lacing mechanism; AI often fails to render interlocking straps correctly, resulting in fusion artifacts. Also, verify if the 'melting' on the left side is a shadow or a genuine structural defect.
